config.neo4j.cypher.topic.ais.positions: WITH __value AS event MERGE (v:Vessel {mmsi: event.mmsi}) ON CREATE SET v.createdAt = datetime() SET v.name = event.name, v.shipType = event.shipType, v.lastLatitude = event.latitude, v.lastLongitude = event.longitude, v.lastSpeedOverGround = event.speedOverGround, v.lastCourseOverGround = event.courseOverGround, v.lastTrueHeading = event.trueHeading, v.lastNavigationalStatus = event.navigationalStatus, v.lastStream = event.stream, v.lastSeen = datetime(event.msgtime), v.updatedAt = datetime()
